description: This line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays the variants as categorical labels: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", is scaled linearly from 56.82 to 66, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2 percentage points. The plot contains three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing Precision, a blue line with circular markers representing Recall, and a brown line with circular markers representing F1-score. The "Full model (Ours)" variant shows the highest performance for all metrics, with Precision at 65.56%, Recall at 65.45%, and F1-score at 65.78%. The "w/o Prompt" variant shows a significant drop in all metrics, with Precision at 61.06%, Recall at 59.64%, and F1-score at 60.16%. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a partial recovery, with Precision at 62.63%, Recall at 62.63%, and F1-score at 62.22%. The "w/o Attention" variant shows a decline, with Precision at 64.06%, Recall at 59.67%, and F1-score at 59.17%. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant shows the lowest performance, with Precision at 65.44%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%.
